text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} is out on a walk, when suddenly...
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}が一人で散歩をしていると──

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hey, it's whiz-boy! Whatcha up to? Just out on a walk?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
ヒデサイじゃん！
なになに？　
散歩ちう？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to work!
I've got a modeling gig I've gotta get to.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちは出勤ちう。
これからモデルの仕事なんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You think I'm super cool for working so hard?
Aw, you're just saying that.
I just really like my job, that's all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
働いてて、
えらいって思う？
そんなことないって。
うち、
モデルの仕事大好きだし。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
And since I like it so much, it's like, super fun!
All my coworkers are like my besties too, so it doesn't feel
like work at all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
好きでやってるから、
おに楽だし、
モデル仲間も友達みたいなものだから、
働いてるって感じでもないんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hey, I know! Why don't you come watch─
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ、
興味あるなら、
見学しても──

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what's with this light?! It's so bright!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ！　
　
なにこの光？
まぶしぃんだけど？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Whattup, whiz-boy? You're as punctual as always!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ、
ちょす～！
約束の時間ぴったりだったね？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
So like, as much as I wanna say let's get a move on and all...
I kinda can't. Sorz! Could you wait like, just a teensy bit
for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
さっそく遊びにいこー！
……って言いたいところなんだけど、
ごめん！　
ちょっち待っててもらってもいい？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
See, I was doing a magazine shoot, but like, they couldn't get
the pictures to come out right, so it's running later than we
thought it would.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いま、
そこで雑誌の撮影してたんだけど、
いい写真が撮れなくてさ、
ちょっち押しちゃってるんだよ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm just like, off or something today.
Idk, like, maybe I'm just too tense, y'know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか、
きょうは調子悪いんだよね？
表情が固いっていうか？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: We've had to take so many pictures, it's taken ages...
text_block_list.orig_text:
何回も撮りなおしてるから、
時間かかっちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
The photographer and the magazine staff are all like,
\"wow, those are some great photos!\"
But I'm like, uh, no they're not!
text_block_list.orig_text:
カメラマンさんとか、
スタッフさんは
いい写真だって言ってくれるけど、
うちが納得できないし！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I'm modeling 'cause I like doing it, so I'm not gonna put on
some half-baked performance. I'm just thinking it might take a
bit longer to get a decent pic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
好きでモデルやってるんだから、
妥協はできないっしょ？
いい写真撮れるまで、
もう少しかかりそうなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You're cool with waiting? You're the best, whiz-boy!
I'll be done in a jiffy, so just sit tight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
待っててくれるの？
ヒデサイ、
ありがと！
すぐに終わらせるから、
待ってて！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: I've gotta finish this quick! My little whiz-boy's waiting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイのためにも、
早く終わらせないと！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Oh hey! There he is! And he's looking right at me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あ！
ヒデサイ、
こっち見てる。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Look at that big ol' wave! Whiz-boy, you're hilarious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは！
ヒデサイ、
あんなおっきく手振っちゃって、
うける～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, what a little dorkus! There's like, so many people
around him, and he's just screaming his head off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ、
わろ～
周りに人いるのに、
大声上げるとか、
目立ちすぎ……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Well, that just shows how hardcore he's cheering for me!
I've gotta put in 110 percent!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
ヒデサイも応援してくれてるんだよね？
うちもがんばろ～！

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Suzuna! If you keep this up, we'll be done in no
time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
鈴奈ちゃん、
すっごくいい表情になってきたわ。
これなら、
すぐに撮影終わりそうね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: For real? Hellaaa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとに？　
やり～！

text_block_list.name: Model Friend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see what's going on here. You're going all out because
your boyfriend's watching!
text_block_list.orig_text:
スズナっち、
あれでしょ？
カレシが見に来たから、
張り切ってる感じ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Wha?! No?! H-he's not my boyfriend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
なっ！？
か、
カレシとかじゃないから！

text_block_list.name: Model Friend
text_block_list.text: You suuure? 'Cause I mean, it sure looks like he is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～？
どう見たって、
付き合ってんじゃん？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: W-well, he's not! He's just a friend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違うから！
ヒデサイはただの友だち！

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Hey, Suzuna, you're looking a little tense again.
Actually, your face is pretty red, too. We're gonna have to
redo these shots.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらぁ？
鈴奈ちゃん、
また表情が固く……
というか、
顔が真っ赤ね？
これじゃあ使い物にならないわ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's you guys' fault for embarrassing me...
I can't concentrate when my heart's pounding like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう……
変なこと言うから……
ドキドキして、
集中できない……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Man, and I was so close to being done too! Now it's gonna take
even longer...
text_block_list.orig_text:
せっかく、
早く終わりそうだったのに、
残りの撮影、
時間かかっちゃうよ……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Oh dear. Looks like you caused some delays in her photo shoot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらら……
けっきょくあんたのせいで、
撮影がおくれちゃったのね～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I have to say, it's really incredible how professional Suzuna
gets when she's working. She's just amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもスズナって、
お仕事の時にはプロモードで真剣になるのね。
かっこいい～！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You want to know what this was?
Riiight. I guess I haven't told you yet.
What you saw just now was a dream I made for you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
今のはなにかって？
あ～、
説明がまだだったわね。
これはね、
あたしが作った『夢』なのよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Though really, I just put it together from Suzuna's and your
memory fragments. I bet it felt pretty familiar, didn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
『夢』っていっても、
あんたとスズナの。
『記憶の欠片』を元に作ったものだからね。
少しは、なつかしかったかしら？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you another dream once you've gathered enough
memory fragments.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたがもっと『記憶の欠片』を集めたら、
また『夢』を見せてあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You'll be having dreams with lots of different girls here,
and that's how you're going to learn the truth of this world.
So do your best, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
たくさんの女の子との『夢』を見ること……
それが
世界の真実にたどり着くことになるはずよ。
がんばってね♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's it for now! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Nnngh... Hm? Huh? Wait, was I sleeping?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
ん～？
あれ？　
うち、
寝ちゃってた？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You too, whiz-boy? Who the heck falls asleep in the middle of
the road? Talk about a bruh moment, amirite?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイも？
道の真ん中で寝ちゃうとか、
うける～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I had like, the weirdest dream. I was planning on hanging out
with you, but then I got held up with work...
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか変な夢も見たんだよね？
ヒデサイと遊ぶ約束してたんだけど、
モデルの仕事が長引いちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You had the same dream? That's like,
totally scarindipitous! What the heck!
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
ヒデサイも同じ夢見てたの？
そんな偶然あるんだ、
超わろ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dangit! I gotta get to my photo shoot!
I gotta go, like, pronto!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──って、
いけない！
うち、
モデルの仕事あるんだった！
急がないと……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! You wanna come too? That way, you can see me
modeling up close and personal! Just like in our dream!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そだ！　
ヒデサイも来る？
うちのモデル姿、
見学できるよ？
夢の中みたいに。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: But wait... In that dream...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
でも夢の時は……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Oh geez, I almost forgot! All my coworkers thought he was my
boyfriend!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！
モデル仲間に、
カレシって勘違いされて……！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Y-you know what? Forget I said anything!
Catch ya later, whiz-boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やっぱ、
いまのなし！
ヒデサイ、
じゃあね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Suzuna took off with her face as red as a tomato.
text_block_list.orig_text:
顔を真っ赤にして、
一人で行ってしまうスズナであった。
